title: Supplier story conflicts with unaffected sites
prompt: Defect rate increased and Supplier B is suspected. Determine the strongest supported explanation.
facts: Defects rose at two plants but remained at baseline at the other three.
The two affected plants installed the same new calibration profile three days before defects rose.
Plants using the old calibration profile did not deteriorate regardless of supplier.
Incoming-material inspection scores for Supplier B were unchanged.
